# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 665207457, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a busy vintage post office sorting room with brass pneumatic tubes whooshing message capsules between clerks at filing cabinets, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
